Development journal

A little clearer.
With every change.

Selected updates from the project changelog. These are development changes, not public release announcements.

4 November 2026

Projects & developer caches

Find the project.
Measure the whole picture.

  • Projects now includes recognised repositories and project folders even when there is nothing to clear.
  • Broader discovery and project-aware build-output matching cover more stacks, with early-stop coverage explained.
  • Cache scans preserve individual unmeasured results and label partial sizes.
  • pnpm store estimates count files not linked by projects; the cleanup tool may still reclaim less than the estimate.
  • pnpm project dependencies distinguish internal package links from links pointing outside the allowed project and store.
3 November 2026

Licensing

Read a saved licence at launch.

  • A saved licence is checked in the background after launch, rather than requiring a visit to Settings.
  • The offline allowance for a previously verified key is now up to 30 days.
  • A saved key can be checked again without re-entering it. Live customer activation and Keychain acceptance remain unverified.
31 October 2026

Storage monitoring

Notice a fast drop in space.

  • An optional fast-drop alert checks free space while Cairn is open and compares known locations when space falls quickly.
  • Changes can retain the measured explanation without treating watched data as cleanable.
  • More developer, local-model and virtual-machine locations are watched.
  • Real fast-drop notifications and the Changes card still need supported-Mac testing.
30 October 2026

Cleanup & evidence

Make the outcome easier to check.

  • Review offers Smart, Delete now and Move to Trash, with an additional acknowledgement for permanent personal-file removal.
  • Receipts distinguish items moved to Trash, action-size estimates and later available-space readings.
  • Trash emptying records each outcome and checks the recorded item.
  • Unreadable folders appear incomplete; the disk map can be stopped and keeps its previous result.
27 October 2026

Projects & the rest of the Mac

Put an idle project to sleep.

  • Projects can prepare rebuildable output for review and save a command to wake the project later.
  • The disk map, duplicate review, app information and app-managed storage guidance were expanded.
  • Messages attachments are measured for review in macOS Storage, rather than removed directly by Cairn.
  • Planned Pro pricing changed to £35.99 once, with no trial. Checkout is not open.
What these dates mean

The repository identifies this work by date and change rather than a released version. Signing, notarisation, live licensing and hardware acceptance remain outstanding. On 9 November, scheduled consent, cancellation and local-model recovery safeguards passed macOS CI and merged. Ruby gem cleanup is now advice only, with legacy commands refused. Physical Mac and live-service acceptance remain open.
